title: Natural Spec to Cloud-Init & Bash Server Provisioner
target_pain: Engineers wasting hours wrestling with Ansible YAML syntax, Jinja indentation errors, and verbose playbooks just to provision small Linux servers or bare metal instances.
key_features: Declarative Server Spec compiler: converts clean multi-line requirements (packages, users, docker containers, firewall rules, cronjobs, swap) into hardened production scripts
Generates dual deployment targets: cloud-config (cloud-init YAML for AWS/Hetzner/DigitalOcean) and Idempotent Standalone Bash script
Integrated live syntax validator & dry-run inspector with instant copy and file download
Pre-built production templates: Hardened Docker Host, Nginx Reverse Proxy & Node, PostgreSQL Database Server
Real deterministic local JS engine - no dummy placeholders or mock API calls
